title: 第1628章 特长班第1627章 王剑学院
content_zh:
“我们剑士拼到底，拼的就是根基与爆发力，她这般模样，怎会是高手？”
“秋水流的剑，从来不靠蛮力。”
一道清冷平淡的男声忽然从两人身侧传来。
众人闻声转头，只见竹影深处走出一名身着素白剑袍的少年。
他发色浅淡，眉眼清寂，周身没有丝毫凌厉的煞气，反倒像山间清风、林间薄雾，沉静得近乎虚无。
正是早先占据最后内班名额的蓝发少年，沈寂。
院内不少人都对他印象深刻，无他，只因此人入校以来从不与人交流，不参与比试，不凑热闹，每日只在竹林练剑，来去孑然一身，孤僻得近乎怪异。
沈寂的目光落在黑发少女身上，没有惊艳，没有轻视，只有一种看穿本质的平静。
“外界剑术，重筋骨、重气力、重杀伐，以力破巧，以快制胜。”他缓缓开口，声线清冷。
“但秋水流的真谛，是借自然之势，顺肌理之柔，以柔蓄锐，以静破刚。看似无锋，实则藏万千锋芒。而她，不止如此。”
话音落下，他抬步往前，主动跟上了少女的步伐。
这一刻，所有围观的学生彻底哗然。
“连沈寂都认可她？”
“我的天，沈寂入校这么久，从来没对任何人说过超过三个字的话，居然主动开口评价新人？”
“难道她真的不是花瓶？是我们看走眼了？”
可就在众人以为即将发生点儿什么的时候。
沈寂却又被一道倩影给拦住了去路。
这是一位发色偏灰的少女。
面容可人，可身材却异常高大，看起来不胖，但骨架比男生还大。
就是这样一位“大女孩”，一举一动却透露出一股柔和。

“班长，为什么拦我？”
沈寂疑惑道。
“今天起，前面改为‘特长班’了，一共只有3名学员。”女孩的话，让众人惊骇。
“什么？”
“什么！？”
这种事情，闻所未闻，或者说，他们就是在见证一次历史。
“我不能去？”沈寂却没有质疑这种可能性。
只因为，他们这一代，天才太多了。
后辈压着前辈打的事情屡见不鲜，尤其是眼前这位灰发少女，完全就是个怪胎，只是跟上她的脚步，就已经拼尽全力了。
可，这个结果，他不服。
抬起头，目光灼灼的看着眼前这位灰发少女问道：
“一个她，一个您，那...还有一个是谁？隔壁班的绿雅，还是刚铎诺夫？”
灰发少女只是淡淡看了他一眼，叹了口气，转身离开了。
只留下一句：“马上你就知道了。”
特长班。
灰发少女一席剑服，端坐在一位老者身旁，缓缓向前推动木盘，红茶微微晃动，却是一滴不曾洒落。
黑发少女接过茶杯，轻轻抿了一口。
不好喝，喝不惯。
但表情没有变化，而是缓缓放下来手中的杯子。
那位老者此刻开口：“我听霍克说，他的师傅曾被一剑击败，他也被一个训练了没几天的小丫头打败。”

黑发少女没有正面回答老者的提问，却是目光灼灼的看着老人：“我不清楚。但我对自己有着绝对的自信，在剑术上。”
“呵。”
老者微微一笑，鼻息明显变化了一番。
content_en:
"When we swordsmen fight to the end, what we fight for is foundation and explosive power. How can she be a master with her appearance?"
"Qiu Shui Shui's sword never relies on brute force."
A cold and calm male voice suddenly came from beside the two of them.
Everyone turned around when they heard the sound, and saw a young man wearing a plain white sword robe walking out of the bamboo shadow.
His hair color was light, his eyebrows were quiet, and there was no sharp evil aura around him. On the contrary, he was like the breeze in the mountains or the mist in the forest, so calm that it was almost nothingness.
It was Shen Ji, the blue-haired boy who had previously occupied the last spot in the inner class.
Many people in the school were deeply impressed by him, but there was no one else. He had never interacted with others, participated in competitions, or joined in the fun since he entered the school. He only practiced swordplay in the bamboo forest every day. He came and went alone, so lonely that it was almost weird.
His silent eyes fell on the black-haired girl. There was no surprise or contempt, only a calmness that saw through the essence.
"External swordsmanship emphasizes muscles and bones, strength, and killing. Strength defeats skill, and speed wins." He spoke slowly, with a cold voice.
"But the true meaning of autumn water is to take advantage of the natural momentum, follow the softness of the texture, use softness to accumulate sharpness, and use stillness to break the hardness. It seems to have no edge, but in fact it hides thousands of edges. And she is more than that."
After the words fell, he stepped forward and took the initiative to keep up with the girl's pace.
At this moment, all the students watching were completely in an uproar.
"Does Shen Shen even recognize her?"
"Oh my God, Shen Shen has been in school for so long and has never said more than three words to anyone, so he actually takes the initiative to comment on the newcomers?"
"Is she really not a vase? Did we make a mistake?"
But just when everyone thought something was about to happen.
Shen Ji was blocked by a beautiful figure again.
This is a girl with gray hair.
He has a pleasant face, but his figure is unusually tall. He doesn't look fat, but his frame is bigger than that of a boy.
She is such a "big girl", but her every move reveals a softness.
"Squad leader, why did you stop me?"
Shen Jing said doubtfully.
"Starting today, the front class has been changed to a 'specialty class'. There are only three students in total." The girl's words shocked everyone.
"What?"
"What!?"
This kind of thing is unheard of, or in other words, they are witnessing history.
"I can't go?" Shen Yan did not question this possibility.
Simply because their generation has too many geniuses.
It is not uncommon for juniors to suppress their seniors and beat them, especially the gray-haired girl in front of them. She is a complete freak, and she is already trying her best just to keep up with her.
However, he was not convinced by this result.
He raised his head, looked at the gray-haired girl in front of him with burning eyes and asked:
"One is her, one is you, then... who is the other one? Lu Ya from the next class, or Gondonov?"
The gray-haired girl just glanced at him lightly, sighed, turned and left.
Only one sentence left: "You will know soon."
Specialty classes.
The gray-haired girl wore a sword uniform and sat next to an old man. She slowly pushed the wooden plate forward. The black tea swayed slightly, but not a drop was spilled.
The black-haired girl took the teacup and took a sip.
It doesn’t taste good and I can’t get used to it.
But his expression did not change, and he slowly put down the cup in his hand.
The old man spoke at this moment: "I heard from Hawke that his master was defeated by a sword, and he was also defeated by a little girl who had only been training for a few days."
The black-haired girl did not answer the old man's question directly, but looked at the old man with burning eyes: "I don't know. But I have absolute confidence in myself in swordsmanship."
"Heh."
The old man smiled slightly, and his breathing changed obviously.
